title: inspired by qsmp2
description: This project is inspired by QSMP 2 and contains the public mods from the serie, as mentioned in Tubbo's live stream, for offline players (not associated to official qsmp)
body:
This project is inspired by QSMP 2 and contains the public mods from the serie, as mentioned in Tubbo's live stream, was made for offline players and doenst have any relation with the official qsmp

all the voice mods and animation was deleted just the main game is ready to play offline

for weak pcs use the make up shader 

croptopia and create aeronautics is also in the modpack just like in qsmp 2
